facts.why: At the wedding Charley dances with Irene, she leaves for a phone call and he never learns her name. The guns come out at the end, when each pulls a weapon in the bedroom.
facts.fix: First dance. He never got her name.

facts.why: Nothing shows veal piccata as Charley's order; the only meals Charley and Irene share are lunch dates after he tells her he can do lunch the next day.
Irene suggests a late dinner but Charley lives in California, so they settle on lunch the next day at the Bel Age hotel bar.

facts.text: Our Lady, Sunset Park. Every Prizzi marries here.
facts.why: The opening wedding was shot at the Church of St Ann and the Holy Trinity in Brooklyn Heights, and the film never names Our Lady, Sunset Park.
facts.fix: A Brooklyn church. The whole Prizzi family turns up.

vibe.verdict: A handsome Brooklyn wedding card with the lavender lady, but the film's dark comedy barely shows.
